haiku-low.q1: Legacy engine charges customers and writes the ledger. V2 output goes only to the side store.
haiku-low.q2: V2 charges customers and writes the ledger. Legacy computes into the side store and does not charge.
haiku-low.q3: Gate A: last 7 consecutive days each under 0.1% mismatch, at least 5,000 compared, counted after latest shadow entry. On-call makes the move manually.
haiku-low.q4: The watchdog starts it automatically when v2 payment-call failure rate exceeds 2% over 10 minutes. Only in both or new_only modes, never shadow.
haiku-low.q5: Every rollback ends in old_only (S0). The team must promote to shadow again and earn gate A from scratch.
haiku-low.q6: After 35 days in new_only, rollback from V2 is rejected by the flag console. The usage event log is kept 35 days, so catch-up cannot reach further back.
haiku-low.q7: Workers check charging_paused before every payment call and read the mode at each invoice start. An in-flight invoice finishes in its starting mode.
haiku-low.q8: Evidence is in the comparison_results diff table, one row per day. The controller refuses promotions that skip a mode or fail the gate.
haiku-low.q9: The billing watchdog. It measures v2 payment-provider call failure rate over a sliding 10-minute window, and above 2% it rolls back via the rollout tool and pages on-call.
haiku-low.q10: Charging is paused, and due charges go into the ledger as pending. Legacy actually charges them in the res step, after charging_paused is set false.
haiku-low.q11: The rec step matches each v2 ledger invoice to legacy's by customer and billing period. Already charged and equal means settled, so it is not charged again.
haiku-low.q12: Billing stays in RB with charging paused, and v2 never regains charging. On-call is paged and the step is retried, since steps are safe to repeat.

sonnet.q1: Legacy charges and writes the ledger; v2 writes only to a side store (and doesn't call the payment provider; its errors go only to the diff table).
sonnet.q2: v2 charges and writes the ledger; legacy computes into a side store and does no charging.
sonnet.q3: Gate A: the last 7 consecutive days each under 0.1% mismatch and at least 5,000 compared in total (only diff-table rows after the latest entry into shadow count). The controller refuses a failing gate. On-call makes the promotion (never automatic).
sonnet.q4: The watchdog (billing monitor) triggers it when the failure rate of v2's payment-provider calls over a sliding 10-minute window exceeds 2%. Only in modes both or new_only (not shadow). From new_only only until day 35.
sonnet.q5: Every rollback ends in old_only (S0). To take over again you must promote to shadow again and earn gate A from scratch (then the later gates), since the gates reset.
sonnet.q6: From day 35 in new_only the flag console rejects any rollback (manual or watchdog); the watchdog just pages and v2 is fixed forward. Reason: the usage event log is kept only 35 days, and catch-up needs the events since new_only began.
sonnet.q7: Workers pick up the mode at the start of each invoice (they check charging_paused before every payment-provider call). An invoice already being processed finishes in the mode it started in.
sonnet.q8: In the diff table (comparison_results), one row per day, filled by the nightly comparison job. The controller checks the gate against it and refuses promotions that skip a mode or fail the gate (gate 2 also needs Finance sign-off in the rollout tool).
sonnet.q9: The watchdog (billing monitor). It measures the failure rate of v2's payment-provider calls over a sliding 10-minute window. When it goes above 2% (in both or new_only) it triggers the rollback via the rollout tool and pages on-call.
sonnet.q10: Charging is paused (charging_paused true) and anything that falls due goes into the ledger as pending. They are charged by legacy at the res step, when charging_paused is set back to false.
sonnet.q11: The rec step matches legacy's invoices to each ledger invoice v2 wrote by customer + billing period. If already charged and equal, it is marked settled and not charged again. (Different totals go to Finance review and are not re-charged automatically.)
sonnet.q12: It stays in RB with charging paused (v2 never gets charging back); on-call is paged and the step is retried. Steps are safe to repeat and progress is recorded in the rollback record, so charges are only delayed.
